text:
New vs returning: use customer_order_number (1 = new, >1 = returning). Revenue = order_total.

SELECT CASE WHEN o.customer_order_number = 1 THEN 'new' ELSE 'returning' END AS customer_segment, SUM(o.order_total) AS revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count FROM jaffle_shop.dev.orders o GROUP BY CASE WHEN o.customer_order_number = 1 THEN 'new' ELSE 'returning' END ORDER BY revenue DESC
